description: Suggested for you — watches for things you do by hand every week and offers to take them over. Every suggestion carries the reason it was made, drawn from your own data.
name: autopilot_suggestions

message.value:
Look at the last month of `interactions`, `loops`, `work_projects` and `board_cards` and find at most three things this person does repeatedly by hand that could run on its own.

For each, write a row into `suggestions` with:
- `proposal`: what it would do, in one plain sentence starting with a verb — 'Every Friday, tell you which deals went quiet this week.'
- `reason`: why you are suggesting it, drawn from THEIR data and naming the specifics — 'You chased three stalled threads by hand this month.' Never a generic tip.
- `status`: 'open'

Rules: only suggest something you could actually build here as a schedule plus a workflow. Do not suggest anything that already exists as an autopilot — check first. Do not repeat a suggestion already in the table, whatever its status. If nothing genuinely repeats, write nothing at all; an empty week is a fine answer and a padded one destroys the value of the section.
